Definition: a man at wages by the day or year
BiblicalUsage: Read sâkîyr as a man at wages by the day or year. It stands in Deuteronomy 15:18, "…double hired servant, in serving thee six years…", and in Exodus 12:45, "…foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that sâkîyr counts, because God put it in his book.
